change.title: Type interrupted Gateway recovery outcomes
change.summary: Changes interrupted Gateway recovery from a string-only result to typed success outcomes and errors. The stop boundary now distinguishes Stopped, NotManaged, and StopUnknown, with StopUnknown retaining whether SIGTERM delivery failed or delivery succeeded but exit was not confirmed. The one-click command projects AuthoritySnapshot or GatewayStart only from the typed error kind and no longer scans Chinese message text. Existing frontend DTO keys, text, coarse stages, journal stage timing, final listener identity recheck, and listener/journal preservation remain unchanged.

basis: focused proxy lifecycle tests passed outside the restricted sandbox with 20 passed, zero failed, and one explicitly ignored isolated listener identity
focused command structured-stage projection test passed with one passed and zero failed
complete Rust library regression passed outside the restricted sandbox with 482 passed, zero failed, and 41 explicitly ignored isolated or live-bound identities
typed assertions distinguish Stopped, NotManaged, signal-delivery failure, and delivered-signal exit-unconfirmed outcomes while retaining the existing safe detail
all three NotNeeded early returns assert the typed outcome and preserve config and journal bytes
journal stage publication still precedes the final process identity callback, and refusal tests retain the listener and journal
command projection assertions prove error kind overrides both missing and misleading Chinese message keywords

the source boundary contract binds the production recovery call to the typed projection helper, requires the exact error-kind to OneClickFailureKind mapping, and forbids message contains classification in that helper
clean-context independent rereview passed with zero BLOCK, HIGH, MEDIUM, or LOW findings after repairing the initial NotNeeded coverage finding
a separate clean-context source-contract rereview passed with zero BLOCK, HIGH, MEDIUM, or LOW findings after binding the production recovery call to the typed helper
